what: The EIP-712 approval that authorized the real mainnet release was produced by the owner's wallet. This re-derives the typed data from stored values and recovers the signer independently of the API.
signerRole: container owner (holder of circuit #10 on processor 4)
note: This signature was accepted by the API and the resulting deployment executed 21 real mainnet writes, so the signature is proven both cryptographically and by consequence.
